# Radoslav Radev Predicts A First Pike Straddle Planche Hold Of Around Three To Five Seconds After 15 Seconds Of Frog Stand

Radoslav Radev predicts that with a foundation of 15 seconds frog stand, you will hold the next step around from three to five seconds. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:35]

## Details

- With enough foundation of 15 seconds frog stand, he says you will hold the pike straddle step around from three to five seconds. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:35]
- With 10, 15 seconds on pike, he says you will be ready to have three seconds on half pike. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 08:23]

## Evidence

- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 07:35 (Radoslav Radev): "But if you have enough foundation of 15 seconds frog stand, definitely you will hold it around from three to five seconds."
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 08:23 (Radoslav Radev): "And if you have 10, 15 seconds on pike, you will be ready to have three seconds on half pike."
